title: Coherent modules under a closed immersion
statement:
Let $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be a
closed immersion of locally
Noetherian schemes, and let $\mathcal F$ be a
coherent module on $X$.
Then $i_*\mathcal F$ is coherent, and
$H^q(Y,i_*\mathcal F)\cong H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ for every $q$.
For an invertible module
$\mathcal L$ on $Y$, the natural map
$i_*\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L\to i_*(\mathcal F\otimes i^*\mathcal L)$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Over an affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}(R)\subset Y$, write $i^{-1}(V)=\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)$; in particular $i$ is affine, hence quasi-compact and separated. By [pqf-lem-pushforward-qcoh] $i_*\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent, so $i_*\mathcal F|_V$ is the module $M=\Gamma(i^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)$ viewed over $R$. Since $X$ is locally Noetherian, [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] makes $\mathcal F$ quasi-coherent of finite type, so $M$ is finite over $R/I$, hence finite over $R$. Thus $i_*\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent of finite type on the locally Noetherian $Y$, and [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] proves it coherent.

The underlying abelian sheaf of the $\mathcal O_Y$-module $i_*\mathcal F$ is the topological direct image of the abelian sheaf underlying $\mathcal F$ along the homeomorphism of $X$ onto the closed subset $i(X)$. By [lem-sc-module-abelian-zariski-cohomology] on $X$ and on $Y$, the cohomology of [pqf-def-cohomology] agrees with abelian-sheaf cohomology on both sides, and [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] gives $H^q(X,\mathcal F)\cong H^q(Y,i_*\mathcal F)$ for every $q$.

Trivialize $\mathcal L$ on an open cover of $Y$ as allowed by [def-sc-invertible-module]. On each member $W$ with $\mathcal L|_W\cong\mathcal O_W$ one has $i^*\mathcal L|_{i^{-1}W}\cong\mathcal O_{i^{-1}W}$, and the natural map becomes the identity of $i_*\mathcal F|_W$. These are the restrictions of the natural map, which is therefore an isomorphism globally.
